nodes.label: Planned playlist CRUD and default Favorites
nodes.norm_label: planned playlist crud and default favorites
nodes.rationale: The changelog lists playlist management under Unreleased/Planned, so it describes intent rather than verified implementation.

nodes.label: Persisted current_playlist setting
nodes.rationale: Restore the selected playlist after app restart using AppSettingRecord; null selects all songs.

nodes.label: Dynamic default Favorites playlist
nodes.rationale: Filter isFavorite dynamically instead of storing a separate list of song paths; protect the default playlist from deletion.

nodes.label: Planned playlist path reconciliation
nodes.rationale: File moves and renames invalidate stored paths. Reconcile after scanning, retain existing paths, match renamed files by duration and size, and remove unmatched deleted paths.

nodes.label: Planned reusable SongPickerPage
nodes.rationale: Reuse multi-select search for new and existing playlists, preselect songs already present and confirm additions through the provider.

nodes.label: Clean Architecture and MVVM
nodes.rationale: Domain and core use pure Dart; dependency rules isolate business logic and are enforced by architecture tests.

nodes.label: Local settings playback and song cache
nodes.norm_label: local settings playback and song cache
nodes.rationale: Store preferences, permission status, recent playback and cached song lists on device; users can erase data or uninstall.

nodes.label: No account personal data upload or tracking policy
nodes.norm_label: no account personal data upload or tracking policy
nodes.rationale: Policy says the offline app does not require accounts, upload music files, collect identifying personal data or use listening history for ad tracking.
